name: plannotator
description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
one_liner: A shared inbox where a team can see everything their AI coding agents produced, leave comments right on it, and send fixes back to the agent with one click.
buyer: An engineering lead at a small dev agency running several AI coding agents at once, who needs one place to review and redirect their output instead of chasing Slack threads and diffs.
business_use_cases: A dev agency running multiple client projects through coding agents uses it as the single review queue before anything ships to a client.
A startup CTO leaves line-level comments on an agent's plan before letting it touch the codebase, cutting rework.
An open-source maintainer uses it to triage and annotate AI-generated pull requests from bot contributors before merging.

money_ideas.idea: Hosted team version with SSO and audit logs for agencies that don't want to self-host
Paid onboarding package wiring it into a client's existing fleet of coding agents

steal_this: Stand up a hosted instance pre-wired to Claude Code and Codex, and pitch it as a 'review inbox for your AI dev team' to the first ten agencies you can find running multiple coding agents.
